pages.text: $(thing)Champions$() (via Champions Unofficial) are elite mob variants that spawn at approximately $(bold)8% base rate$() across all dimensions. They glow, have custom affixes, and are significantly more dangerous than standard mobs.$(br2)Champions are the primary source of good early affix items. Killing one is always worth the effort.

$(bold)Champion Ranks$()$(br2)$(bold)Rank 1 (Common)$() — 1 affix. Slightly buffed stats.$(br)$(bold)Rank 2 (Elite)$() — 2 affixes. Noticeably stronger.$(br)$(bold)Rank 3 (Champion)$() — 3 affixes. Serious threat. Good loot.$(br)$(bold)Rank 4 (Legendary)$() — 4 affixes. Boss-level threat. Excellent loot.$(br2)Higher ranks are rarer. Rank 4 $(thing)Champions$() are uncommon enough to be memorable encounters.

$(bold)Affix Pool$()$(br2)$(thing)Champions$() draw from 16 built-in affixes plus 5 custom $(thing)IridescentCraft$() affixes. Some affix combinations are extremely dangerous — for example, Commanding (buffs nearby mobs) combined with Summoning (spawns reinforcements) in a cave.$(br2)$(bold)Anti-cheese note:$() Champions are designed to not be kitable with basic ranged attacks. Magnetic and Leaping affixes exist specifically to punish pure-range cheese strategies.
